notes.subject: שמוע שמעתי
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute doubled with the verb: 'hearing I heard' — intensity, lost as single 'harim olgeta'.

notes.subject: השיבני / ואשובה
notes.rationale: Same root שוב twice: 'turn me and I will turn' — the root that anchors this whole return passage.

notes.subject: מתנודד
notes.rationale: From נוד 'to nod/waver': 'bemoaning himself' (KJV/JPS) vs 'trembling/wandering' — I chose the bodily picture 'nagim het' (shaking the head).

notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks copula in 'ki attah YHWH' — Tok Pisin requires ⟨yu⟩.

notes.subject: Efrayim i tok long Yahwe
notes.rationale: Direct address of Ephraim's prayer to Yahwe, 'my Elohim'.

translation: Harim olgeta, mi harim Efrayim i nagim het: Yu skruim mi, na mi kisim skru, olsem pikinini bulmakau man i no trenim yet; bringim mi bek, na bai mi kamap bek, bilong ⟨yu⟩ Yahwe, Elohim bilong mi.
